route_grace_aa.grace: main.idle_cycles (route id -> consecutive idle cycles, runtime only, not saved) updated in _end_cycle; main.display_status() returns running for stalled/waiting until 2 idle cycles; blocked at once. Used by the map lines and by the panel ship rows. NOT_ROUTE_STALLED first-cycle notice untouched. After a load the counters start at 0 (grace again).
route_grace_aa.aa_cause: Line shader computed the strip side as normalize(cross(tangent, view ray)); when a line is seen end-on that is zero, giving NaN and a vanished or flickering strip (dashed/waiting and solid alike). Added a fixed-axis fallback in the shader and a GDScript mirror route_line.side_vector. Chevron arms use world-fixed offsets and were not changed; art/route PNGs are not used by this shader.
route_grace_aa.tests: TOTAL pass=757 fail=1 expected (known sys2 Quillon); see run output. Headless cannot render the shader: the test checks the mirrored side vector and that the shader has the fallback, not the pixels.
route_grace_aa.not_checked_visually: All of the angle fix (the cause is from reading the shader, not from seeing it), dashed look, chevron at extreme angles.
